hero.title: Water, made visible for your community
hero.tagline: MyWell is a free, community-focused water monitoring and learning app, built on the MARVI approach to participatory groundwater management. Record readings from wells, rain gauges and other local water sources — then see them on a map and watch the trends.
hero.note: Works in your browser, on iPhone and on Android.

features.title: Stations for every source
features.text: Wells, boreholes, rain gauges, check dams, rivers, springs, reservoirs, rainwater tanks and more — with photographs, notes and locations.

features.title: Field-ready recording
features.text: Log groundwater levels, rainfall, water quality, surface water and storage readings in seconds, right at the station.

features.title: Interactive map
features.text: Every station on one map. Draw a monitoring area to focus on the wells, gauges and dams that matter to you.

features.title: Trends and comparisons
features.text: Compare current and historical measurements with simple charts, summaries and seasonal patterns.

features.title: Water-quality safe bands
features.text: Quality readings are charted against safe-range guidance, so out-of-range values stand out immediately.

features.title: QR codes on stations
features.text: Print a QR code for a station; scanning it opens that station directly in the app — perfect for shared field sites.

features.title: Teams and organisations
features.text: Work as a group: organisations manage their own members, stations and data, with clear roles for contributors and viewers.

features.title: Bulk data upload
features.text: Bring existing records with you — template-based file uploads move whole station histories into MyWell.

features.title: 60+ languages
features.text: The whole app — menus, forms, guided tours — is available in more than sixty languages.

shots.caption: Find stations anywhere on the map
Record a visit in under a minute
Watch trends build over the seasons

steps.title: Create a free account
steps.text: Sign up with your name and email. New members can record data straight away, and a built-in tour shows you around.

steps.title: Add your stations
steps.text: Register the wells, rain gauges, dams or springs you monitor — name, location, type, photo. Each gets its own page and code.

steps.title: Record readings
steps.text: On each visit, log the water level, rainfall or quality readings — with photos and notes if you like.

steps.title: Watch the trends
steps.text: Charts and summaries build up automatically. Compare seasons, spot declines early, and share the picture with your community.

tutorials.title: Watch how it's done
tutorials.subtitle: Nine short tutorials, narrated, recorded from the real app. Start with the first one and you will have an account in about three minutes.

items.title: Create your account
items.text: Start here. We fill the sign-up form in together — your name, country, choosing a username, and a password that will hold — then sign in with it.

items.title: Your Home screen
items.text: What you see every time you open MyWell: your stations at a glance, your own map, the record-a-reading shortcut and your recent activity.

items.title: Add and manage your stations
items.text: Register the wells, rain gauges, dams and springs you look after, and keep the list tidy as it grows.

items.title: Record a reading
items.text: A complete visit from start to save — choosing the station, entering water level or quality, adding a photo, and saving it.

items.title: Find stations on the map
items.text: Both maps explained: your own station map and the all-stations map, with the area and station-type filters.

items.title: Areas, trends and statistics
items.text: Read the shared dataset: pick a monitoring area, then read its water-level trend chart and its summary statistics.

items.title: Build your own chart
items.text: The chart builder — add data series, pick stations and data types, set the time range, and save a view to come back to.

items.title: Weather and rainfall
items.text: Rain is where groundwater comes from. The Weather page puts the forecast beside the wells it will feed.

items.title: Settings and your language
items.text: Make MyWell yours: switch between sixty-one languages, change the display and theme, and replay any part of the built-in tutorial.

datasets.title: Australia — groundwater
datasets.text: Bureau of Meteorology bores from the Global Groundwater Monitoring Network — about 25,000 wells with decades of water-level history.

datasets.title: India — groundwater
datasets.text: Central Ground Water Board stations via the Global Groundwater Monitoring Network — about 40,000 wells with quarterly readings.

datasets.title: Australia — rivers
datasets.text: WaterNSW surface-water gauges, with millions of river-level readings across New South Wales.

datasets.title: Your community
datasets.text: Readings from farmers, volunteers, schools and researchers — the MARVI citizen-science record that started it all, growing every day.

store.note: MyWell is free on Google Play and the App Store. Prefer not to install? The web app has every feature too.

faq.a: Nothing. MyWell is a free, community-focused app developed through the MARVI project for education, citizen science and community water management.

faq.q: Can I use it on both my phone and a computer?
faq.a: Yes — the same account works in the web app and the mobile app, and your stations and readings stay in sync.

faq.q: Who can see the data I record?
faq.a: Readings join a shared water-monitoring dataset that signed-in users can explore, but your personal details are visible only within your own organisation. Location of stations is part of the shared record; who recorded a reading is not public.

faq.q: Do I need to be an expert?
faq.a: No. MyWell was built with farmers, students and community volunteers — a guided tour walks you through the app, and recording a reading takes under a minute.

faq.q: I forgot my password — what do I do?
faq.a: Use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen and we'll email you a reset code.
Yes, at any time, directly in the app: Settings → Delete account. Your account and personal data are removed immediately.

faq.q: I have existing records in spreadsheets — can I import them?
faq.a: Yes. MyWell has template-based bulk upload for stations and measurements, so existing histories can move in without retyping.

cta.title: Start making your water visible
cta.subtitle: Join farmers, schools, researchers and agencies already monitoring their local water with MyWell.

audience: MyWell is designed for farmers, community volunteers, schools, universities, researchers, non-government organisations and government agencies. It supports practical learning, citizen science and informed discussion about groundwater, rainfall, surface water and other local water resources.
